subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Tom Petters and the Phantom Merchandise
description: A fast breakdown of Tom Petters and the Phantom Merchandise for builders.

hook.text: Tom Petters told investors he was buying electronics in bulk and reselling them to big retailers.

buildup.text: He showed purchase orders and shipping documents. Investors earned handsome returns for years.

discovery.text: There was no merchandise. The purchase orders were forged. Returns came from new investors.

twist.text: His own CFO wore a wire for the FBI, secretly recording months of incriminating conversations.

climax.text: Petters was convicted of $3.65 billion in fraud and sentenced to 50 years in prison.

punchline.text: He sold products that didn't exist to people who didn't check.

quiz.question: How was Tom Petters caught?
options: His CFO wore a wire for the FBI
